'''Meldark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who proclaimed himself the preeminent [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] on [[Level 35]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="TF" /> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> He spent a good deal of time at the [[Dark Melody]] bar, where the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] variation, [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]], was actively discussed.<ref name="TF" />
